candidates.change_summary: Removed the line that decreases totalSupply so burning no longer reduces totalSupply.
Added an extra decrement of totalSupply so burning reduces totalSupply twice as much.
Changed the onlyOwner check to require msg.sender != owner, inverting the ownership guard so burn can be called by non-owners and thus change who pays burn affecting totalSupply observable behavior.
Moved the totalSupply decrement to after emit Burn so ordering of state change vs event is altered (observable ordering in logs vs state).
Require that msg.sender has strictly greater than _value (>) instead of >=, preventing burning full balance and thus changing balanceOf after burn.
Remove the line that decreases totalSupply, so burning no longer reduces totalSupply but still decreases balanceOf, changing observable supply-related balances.
Change the function to subtract the burned amount from the caller's balance twice, making balanceOf decrease more, altering post-burn balances.
Move the totalSupply decrement before adjusting the caller's balance, changing reentrancy/visibility ordering that can affect observed balances in some call sequences.
Change the onlyOwner helper to require msg.sender != owner, flipping the check so functions using onlyOwner behave oppositely and affecting who can call burn.
